subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: Each religon claims that its own holy book is the direct concealment of God.
Each religion claims that its own holy book is the direct conceelment of God.
Each religion claims that its own holi book is the direct concealment of God.
Each religion claims that its own holy book is the direct concealment of God.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"religion"** means a particular system of faith and worship. (धर्म)

 
 
• **Example: **Christianity is a **religion **based on the life and teachings of Jesus Christ.
 
 
 
• **"Concealment"** refers to the action of hiding something or preventing it from being known. (छिपाव)
 
 
• **Example: **The **concealment **of the truth was a major factor in the investigation.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "Each religon claims that its own holy book is the direct concealment of God." (धर्म)

 
 
• **Explanation:** The word "religon" is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "religion".
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Each religion claims that its own holy book is the direct conceelment of God." (छिपाव)
 
 
• **Explanation:** The word "conceelment" is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "concealment".
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Each religion claims that its own holi book is the direct concealment of God." (पवित्र)
 
 
• **Explanation:** The word "holi" is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "holy".
